# mtncloud_user (Data Source)

Looks up one user by ID or by name, including one made in the console. Users of your tenant. A name must match exactly one user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# By name (matched exactly); `id = 123` works too.
data "mtncloud_user" "example" {
  username = "jane"
}

output "user_email" {
  value = data.mtncloud_user.example.email
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (Number) ID of the user. Give this or `username`.
- `username` (String) Name of the user, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `account_locked` (Boolean) Whether the account is locked.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `email` (String) Email address.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the user can log in.
- `first_name` (String) First name.
- `last_login_date` (String) Last login (RFC 3339), or empty.
- `last_name` (String) Last name.
- `password_expired` (Boolean) Whether the password has expired.
- `roles` (List of String) Names of the user's roles.
